findings.message:
Reentrancy in LuckyDoubler.join() (../sb/lucky_doubler.sol#67-122):
	External calls:
	- msg.sender.send(msg.value - 1000000000000000000) (../sb/lucky_doubler.sol#74)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- balance += (dValue * (100 - fee)) / 100 (../sb/lucky_doubler.sol#92)
	- entries.push(Entry(msg.sender,dValue,(dValue * (multiplier) / 100),false)) (../sb/lucky_doubler.sol#87)
	- unpaidEntries.push(entries.length - 1) (../sb/lucky_doubler.sol#89)
	- users[msg.sender].id = msg.sender (../sb/lucky_doubler.sol#81)
	- users[msg.sender].deposits = 0 (../sb/lucky_doubler.sol#82)
	- users[msg.sender].payoutsReceived = 0 (../sb/lucky_doubler.sol#83)
	- users[msg.sender].deposits ++ (../sb/lucky_doubler.sol#88)
findings.name: reentrancy-unlimited-gas

findings.message:
Reentrancy in LuckyDoubler.join() (../sb/lucky_doubler.sol#67-122):
	External calls:
	- msg.sender.send(msg.value - 1000000000000000000) (../sb/lucky_doubler.sol#74)
	- theEntry.entryAddress.send(payout) (../sb/lucky_doubler.sol#102)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- balance -= payout (../sb/lucky_doubler.sol#106)
	- theEntry.paid = true (../sb/lucky_doubler.sol#103)
	- unpaidEntries[index] = unpaidEntries[unpaidEntries.length - 1] (../sb/lucky_doubler.sol#109)
	- unpaidEntries.length -- (../sb/lucky_doubler.sol#111)
	- users[theEntry.entryAddress].payoutsReceived ++ (../sb/lucky_doubler.sol#104)
